Very good for me.
Jul 2026 • Family
Vladimir, here's a review that looks natural, doesn't look like it's a custom one, but it highlights the merits of the restaurant and Chan's owner.

When traveling, I'm always looking for places with a soul, not just restaurants with good cuisine. The Coral turned out to be just that. It all adds up to the same impression: fresh seafood, well-prepared dishes, large portions, beautiful interior and a truly warm atmosphere.

I want to thank the restaurant owner Chan separately. It's very rare to meet a man who loves his business so sincerely. He talks to his guests, takes care of every detail, and makes it feel like you're not coming to a tourist restaurant, but to visit a good friend. It's because of people like this that I want to come back again.

If you're in Nha Trang and want to taste quality seafood without compromise, I strongly recommend this place. For our company, it was one of the best restaurants of the entire trip. Thank you, Chan! We'll definitely be back. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

We're definitely not going back again.
